text: Employees receive 20 days of annual leave every calendar year. Employees can carry forward up to 5 unused annual leave days into the following year. Employees should submit leave requests through the HR system at least 3 working days before the requested leave date. Emergency leave may be requested without the normal advance notice.

Employees who complete at least one year of service are eligible for the company's health insurance program. The company provides health insurance coverage for employees and eligible dependents. Employees may also participate in the retirement savings program. The company contributes 5 percent of the employee's eligible salary to the retirement savings program when the employee contributes at least 5 percent. Employees can contact the HR benefits team for questions about insurance and retirement benefits.
Our company provides software products and technology services to customers around the world. Employees are expected to work professionally and collaborate effectively with their teams.
The standard working schedule is Monday through Friday. Employees should normally be available during their team's scheduled working hours.
